exposure: Probiotic supplementation (Limosilactobacillus reuteri PBS072 and Bifidobacterium breve BB077 plus multivitamins)
outcome: Symptoms related to maternal depression (EPDS score)
cohort: The study included 200 healthy new mothers during the first trimester after delivery.
finding: Probiotic treatment significantly ameliorated mothers' mood, improved breastfeeding quality, and reduced baby's cries compared to the control group.
